svg.title: Checkout is a transaction, payment is a protocol
svg.desc: A browser return or a model response is never proof that money was received.
svg.text: Checkout is a transaction, payment is a protocol
A browser return or a model response is never proof that money was received.
1. Customer reviews the server quote
Cart capability + revision + reviewed total; final address, delivery and payment selection
2. Atomic order commit
Lock cart, settings and product rows
Calculate existing Shopware-compatible quote
Persist exact EUR Money + order + allocation + outbox
Deduct stock once; idempotent replay returns the order
3. Durable payment job
Freeze provider version, account, currency and environment
Claim lease → external request → fenced receipt
Amount / identity / signature checks + state machine
Lost reply becomes uncertain; reconcile before releasing
Manual or simulated cancellation
Guard order/payment/delivery state
Release persisted allocation quantity once
Edited JSON cannot manufacture restocked inventory
Captured / refunded / late capture
Verified receipt owns the monetary transition
Void confirmed authorization before stock release
Late capture goes to payment review; refund is explicit
Vendune · executable boundaries first · private integrations stay separate
